children.prompt: Find the areas of rectangle $ABCD$ and the shaded rectangle.

answer.worked:
Rectangle $ABCD$ has width $2x+x=3x$ cm and height $3+3=6$ cm. Area = length × width.

$$\begin{align*}A_{ABCD}&=3x\times6\\A_{ABCD}&=18x\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=2x\times3\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=6x\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
